name: connectwise-control
description: ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect): sessions and a read-only escape hatch to the Control API. Beta.
long_description:
ConnectWise Control (ScreenConnect) as a local MCP server, in beta. List sessions and reach other Control endpoints through cw_control_api_request (GET only).

Every tool is named cw_control_* and shows a Title Case name in the client. Both tools are read-only and carry readOnlyHint.

This bundle runs on your own machine and holds the Control credentials there. PSA and Automate ship as separate bundles from the same repository.

tools.name: Control API Request
tools.description: Call a ConnectWise Control endpoint; POST needs confirm: true (beta) — writes to ConnectWise

screenconnect_password.title: Control password
screenconnect_password.description: Control account password. Supply it from your secret manager.
